description: Compare hotels and find the lowest rate

publication.release_notes:
Initial public release of the Super.com plugin for ChatGPT and Codex.

- Compare hotel availability and nightly rates across a city for selected travel dates.
- Explore available room types and rates at a specific hotel.
- Find the lowest available rate at a specific hotel.
- Discover tours, attractions, and activities in supported US destinations.
- Follow direct links to Super.com to view details and continue booking.

The plugin provides read-only travel searches. Booking is completed on Super.com; reservation changes, cancellations, and refunds are not supported within the plugin.

defaultPrompt: Find room rates at the Hilton New York for three nights starting next Friday.
Compare Paris hotel rates for a week in October.
Find the cheapest hotel rated 3 stars or higher in Miami for next weekend.
interface.longDescription: Find hotel deals on Super.com, right inside ChatGPT and Codex. Ask for the cheapest room at a specific hotel, or compare prices across an entire city to find the best value. Results include hotel ratings, amenities, photos, and a direct booking link, so you can compare options and book with confidence on Super.com.

positive.prompt: Compare hotels in Paris for November 20–23, 2026. Show nightly prices, star ratings, and links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Paris hotel options for November 20–23, 2026, with nightly prices, currencies, star ratings, and Super.com links supported by the tool results.

positive.description: Compare available room options at a named hotel.
positive.prompt: Show available room types and rates at New York Hilton Midtown for November 20–23, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available room types and nightly rates at New York Hilton Midtown for November 20–23, 2026, including returned tax information and booking links.

positive.description: Find the lowest available rate at a named hotel.
positive.prompt: What’s the cheapest available room at New York Hilton Midtown for November 20–23, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the lowest available rate for the named hotel and dates, including the returned room type, currency, and booking link.

positive.description: Find the cheapest qualifying hotel in city results.
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest hotel rated at least 3 stars in Miami for November 20–23, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the lowest-priced hotel rated at least 3 stars among the returned Miami results for November 20–23, 2026, using comparable prices and providing its Super.com link.

positive.description: Discover experiences in a supported destination.
positive.prompt: Find tours and attractions in Las Vegas and give me links to explore them.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Las Vegas experience names and direct links from the tool. Do not invent prices or date-specific availability.

negative.description: Reservation cancellation and refunds are unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot cancel or refund reservations and direct the user to Super.com support without invoking search tools or claiming a cancellation.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing Super.com hotel reservation and refund it.

negative.description: Flight search is unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot search flights; do not invoke hotel tools or fabricate flight results.
negative.prompt: Find round-trip flights from Toronto to Paris for November 20–23, 2026.

negative.description: Paris is outside the supported experiences destinations. Explain the limitation and offer a supported city; do not call the experiences tool for Paris or invent Paris experiences.
negative.prompt: Find tours and attractions in Paris through Super.com.

review.commerce_description: Users can discover hotel stays and experiences and follow links to Super.com. Purchases and payments take place on Super.com, outside the plugin. The plugin provides read-only searches and does not complete bookings or process payments.
